description: This script is a utility tool for fixing nvcc dependency files by converting relative paths to absolute paths and ensuring proper dependency tracking in build systems. It wraps the nvcc compiler to modify dependency output, primarily used in CUDA build workflows.

methods.name: resolve_include
methods.description: Resolves a given include path to an absolute path by searching through include directories.

methods.name: repair_depfile
methods.description: Reads a dependency file and rewrites it with absolute paths for any relative paths found.

methods.name: extract_include_arg
methods.description: Extracts include directory paths from command-line arguments and updates the include_dirs list.
